title: Dunjunz, Ole's crack of the cassette (1986)
label: The game
notes: DUNJ4 and DUNJ3 from Dunjunz-tape.zip in the NVG archive, a crack of the 1986 cassette by Ole ("The great Demon from Denmark"). DUNJ4 (the figures above) is the game's &0400-&2FFF image stored at &2400, followed by start-up code at &5000 that copies it into place and applies the cracker's start-level cheat. DUNJ3 (load &6E80, 11904 bytes; SHA-256 03d92abc11b36d22e2a9a7365ee90aa47f32aa6d2e243188e3f5fdc423abbd22) holds &6E80-&7FFF. The levels are stored decrypted and loaded with *LOAD. The game listing saves both files. EXPAND, the picture unpacker that PLOAD runs, is disassembled on its own; PLOAD and DUNJ are shown as source, with the manual that DUNJ carries after its program and prints when I is pressed.

disassemblies.label: *EXPAND: picture unpacker
disassemblies.runtime: EXPAND, load and exec &2E00, &1A7 bytes, "(C) 1985 Rhys E. Davies". Run by PLOAD as *EXPAND GIRL1 in MODE 2: loads the packed picture so that it ends at &8000 and unpacks it onto the screen from &3000 with all the colours black, then reveals it with VDU 20. Each packed byte holds six bits of a screen byte and a run length of 1-3, or a count in the next byte.
